source.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2024 1-year: aggregate real estate taxes over aggregate value of owner-occupied homes (B25090/B25082), by state; national 0.89%. Puerto Rico's answers are unreliable and the island areas have no ACS, so they use the national rate as an estimate.

propertytaxbystate.com, 'When Are Property Taxes Due? 2026 Deadlines for All 50 States' (https://propertytaxbystate.com/blog/when-are-property-taxes-due), read Oct 19, 2026; a commercial summary of state and county due dates, not a statute; cross-checked against Avalara's 2024 due-date table (https://www.avalara.com/blog/en/north-america/2024/01/state-property-tax-bill-due-dates.html), which disagrees on Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas and Connecticut.
source.note: Delinquency dates are not recorded: the source lists due dates only.

dueDates.day: A number is the day of the month; 'last' is the month's last day; nth and weekday (1 = Monday) name 'the nth Monday'.

AK.estimatedFrom: No single date found: the state leaves bill dates to each county or town. Two bills a year, in the spring and the fall, the pattern of the states that set dates by statute.
AK.spread: One to four bills a year, any month.

AL.estimatedFrom: The state's most common bill dates; a statewide statute or the state's collectors' common practice; a county can differ.
AL.spread: A county's own dates can sit weeks either side.
